_meta.system: Bilge Pump System — BilgePumpA/B Hydraulic Model
_meta.description: Pump performance curve data exported from OpenFOAM steady-state RANS simulation at 5 operating points. Provides Q-H curve, efficiency curve, and NPSH curve for use in SysML constraint def parametric bindings.

constraints.name: PumpFlowPhysics
constraints.description: Net effective discharge flow rate accounting for hydraulic efficiency and Darcy-Weisbach pipe friction losses. Based on OpenFOAM k-ε RANS simulation at rated impeller speed (2950 RPM).

parameters.name: Q_A
parameters.description: Pump A volumetric flow rate at rated speed

parameters.name: Q_B
parameters.description: Pump B volumetric flow rate (identical to A)

parameters.name: eta
parameters.description: Hydraulic efficiency — best efficiency point from CFD

parameters.name: lambda
parameters.description: Darcy-Weisbach pipe friction factor from P&ID hydraulic calc

operating_points.note: Low flow — left side of curve

constraints.equation_standard: Darcy-Weisbach; ISO 9906 — Rotodynamic pump performance test
constraints.verification_notes: Valid for turbulent flow Re > 4000; k-ε model used with wall functions. Grid sensitivity study: 5 meshes from 200k to 2.1M cells; GCI < 1.2%.

constraints.name: PumpCavitationMarginCheck
constraints.description: Ensures available NPSH at pump inlet exceeds required NPSH from CFD curve plus design margin.

parameters.name: npsh_available
parameters.description: NPSH available from suction piping geometry

parameters.name: npsh_required
parameters.description: NPSH required at rated flow from CFD curve

parameters.name: npsh_margin
parameters.description: Safety margin per Hydraulic Institute Standards (1.0 m minimum)
